description: Split a PDF into multiple files by page range. Each element of ranges becomes one file, named "<prefix>1.pdf", "<prefix>2.pdf", and so on. Pages are copied into a new document, so document-level information (tagged structure, XMP, attachments, AcroForm, bookmarks, etc.) is not carried over. Anything lost is reported in warnings; follow up on the output with attach_file / ensure_tagged / add_bookmarks / set_metadata as needed.

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

inputPath.description: Absolute path of the PDF to split.

ranges.description: Array of page ranges. Each element is "1-3" / "5" / "7-" / "-2" (1-based). Example: ["1-3", "4-"].

name: split_pdf
title: Split PDF
